name: Mandate
definition: Authorisation given by an issuing party to a holder party to act on the issuer's behalf.

MandateIdentification.name: Mandate Identification
MandateIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the mandate.

TrackingDays.name: Tracking Days
TrackingDays.definition: Specifies the number of days the mandate must be tracked.

TrackingIndicator.name: Tracking Indicator
TrackingIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the direct debit instructions should be automatically re-submitted periodically when bilaterally agreed.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Pre-agreed increase or decrease rate that will be applied to the collection amount.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Regularity with which payment instructions are to be created and processed.

SignatureConditions.name: Signature Conditions
SignatureConditions.definition: Specifies the signature requirements related to the document.

MandatePartyRole.name: Mandate Party Role
MandatePartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a mandate and played by a party in that context.

MandateStatus.name: Mandate Status
MandateStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a mandate

AccountContract.name: Account Contract
AccountContract.definition: Contract on which a mandate applies.

Authentication.name: Authentication
Authentication.definition: Specifies the transport authentication details related to the mandate.

MandatePaymentType.name: Mandate Payment Type
MandatePaymentType.definition: Identifies the type of mandate (service level and/or paper or electronic) being requested or given by the initiating party.
